items.exampleEn: The ball is on the ground.
This is the site of the new school.
items.exampleZh: 這裡是新學校的預定地。

items.exampleEn: My mother works at a hospital.
There is an old church in our town.
items.exampleZh: 我們鎮上有一座老教堂。

items.exampleEn: I go to the bank to get some money.
The officer at the airport asks me some questions.
items.exampleZh: 機場的官員問了我一些問題。
那個告示寫著「禁止吸菸」。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't sit on the ground.

items.audioEn: The hospital is on this street, near the bank.
items.audioZh: 醫院在這條街上，在銀行附近。

items.sentenceEn: They are building a new hospital on this site.
items.sentenceZh: 他們正在這塊地上蓋新醫院。

items.sentenceEn: An officer from the city visits our school.
items.sentenceZh: 一位市府官員來參觀我們學校。

items.stemEn: I put my money in the ____.
My father is sick. He is in the ____.
items.stemZh: 我爸爸生病了，他在醫院。

items.passageEn: Welcome to our town! The bank is on Park Street, near the old church. The hospital is on the other side of the street. Look for the big red sign. The man at the door can help you.
items.passageZh: 歡迎來到我們鎮上！銀行在公園街上，靠近那座老教堂。醫院在街道的另一邊，找那個紅色的大招牌就對了。門口的那位先生可以幫你。

referenceEn: Excuse me, where is the bank?
rubricZh: 問地點例如用 Where is…?（可縮寫成 Where's）；寫 Can you tell me where the bank is? 也正確
「請問」可用 Excuse me 開頭，或在句尾加 please

referenceEn: There are many shops on this street.
rubricZh: 「在街上」常用 on（例如 on this street）
可寫，例如 There are many shops…、This street has… 等；「商店」寫 shops 或 stores 都正確
